Emma — thanks for the clear summary and for looping Rajiv. Quick response with concrete artifacts and a proposed safety plan:

1) Recommended variants to evaluate (shortlist):
- redwood-7b-q4f: fast, quantized 7B; good for low latency realtime enrichment.
- redwood-stable-13b: higher quality for explanation snippets and edge-case consistency.
- redwood-13b-sparse-kv: experimental memory-optimized variant for long-context merchant histories.

2) Attached artifacts (zipped stubs attached below):
- techpay-eval-benchmarks-v1.csv — candidate prompts vs. gold labels (precision/recall/ hallucination flags).
- techpay-promptset-v1.txt — sanitized prompt set we used in the call.
- model-snapshot-metadata.json — example snapshot metadata to use for pinning.

3) Quality regression / version-safety proposal (high level):
- Snapshot + pin: we recommend you pin a snapshot id for the trial phase (example in attached model-snapshot-metadata.json). Pinning ensures the hosted route serves the immutable model variant until you explicitly update.
- Canary rollout + telemetry: run new model variant on 10% of requests in shadow mode (no impact) and compare golden metrics (FP rate, hallucination counts, latency distribution).
- Automated rollback triggers: if FP increases by >3% absolute or hallucination rate doubles on the golden set, the route auto-falls back to the pinned snapshot.
- Emergency manual rollback: ops playbook (one-click rollback in Console + API) — we can pre-create the rollback runbook and test it with TechPay test traffic.

4) Next steps / ask list (proposed):
- Rajiv: share 200 representative prompts (dev/test) and any gold labels. S3 or Drive link is fine.
- TechPay: confirm target latency SLA and whether the trial will be host-provided or Dedicated. The latency target you mentioned (250ms) will likely push us to the 7B quantized variant for realtime flows.
- Redwood: we will package an eval report (link below) and propose a two-week trial window. If you want, we can pin a snapshot for the trial window so you can validate before re-opening model updates.

Links:
- Eval report (draft): s3://redwood-evals/techpay/20260918/eval-report.html
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/TP-2026-09-18-42

Attachments: techpay-eval-benchmarks-v1.csv, techpay-promptset-v1.txt, model-snapshot-metadata.json

I can schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through the eval artifacts and configure the pin/canary flows. What times work for you?

Thanks — Chloe

Chloe — congrats on a crisp summary. Quick internal note:
- For a prospect with firm rollback requirements, we should offer a pre-configured pinned snapshot for the pilot (no charge to create). That lowers their risk and speeds validation.
- Suggest we set the canary shadow to 10% and configure two alert hooks: FP delta and hallucination token patterns. We have templates for the alert thresholds — I can attach the playbook if helpful.

Emma/Rajiv — we will not enable automatic model-only updates on the pinned route during the pilot unless you opt in. If you want Dedicated capacity for strict latency, flag that in the reply and I'll loop infra.

—Karthik
